# Awesome GitHub

Machine-readable index for the public site.

## Pages

- `/` - Home
- `/wceu-2026/` - WCEU 2026 talk
- `/wceu-2026/slides/` - WCEU 2026 slides index
- `/wceu-2026/slides/<slug>/` - Individual WCEU 2026 slide pages
- `/why-this-exists/` - Why this exists
- `/references/` - References

## Notes

- The WCEU section scans the full `wceu-2026` tree for accessibility advice, slide copy, and source references.
- Each slide has a dedicated public page under `/wceu-2026/slides/` with its own references and source link.
- The public site focuses on the conference talk, the repo-as-control-plane model,
  and the supporting references.
- Additional pages can be added without changing the shared shell.
